integrity: General result has a self-contained proof, a separate finite checker, and an explicit statement that finite tests are corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Binary Hamming cube with closed radius-one incidence; maximal contranominal subcontexts, not a full enumeration of Boolean suborders or scales of smaller dimension. Literature-wide priority is not independently certified.
title: A four-dimensional ceiling and two geometric families of Boolean scales in binary Hamming contexts
